title: Quick chips and Tags & note — round 3

steps.path: The pencil at the end of the chips above the message box
steps.headline: Which quick chips editor?
steps.notice: All three: a labelled card, "+ Add a chip" below. B and C are sketches: their reordering gets wired up if picked.

variants.label: Rows
variants.summary: Last round's: each chip a row with its message under the name, a grip to drag, a pencil to edit in place, ✕ to remove.

variants.label: The chips themselves
variants.summary: The chips drawn as they look above the message box. Click one to edit its name and message in a box below (with Remove); drag one to move it.
variants.risk: You can't read what a chip sends until you click it.

variants.label: Always editable
variants.summary: Every chip's name and message are open boxes you type into directly; no edit step. Grip and ✕ on each.
variants.risk: Long: about 4 chips fit before scrolling; easy to change one by accident.

steps.path: The tag chip in the status bar
steps.headline: Pin is its own switch at the top; no tick boxes. How should a tag show it's on?
steps.notice: Both: "Pin to top" card first (Priority's new name, same saved mark, so sessions marked Priority come up pinned); the note box no longer resizes; Priority is gone from the tag list.

variants.label: A switch on each tag
variants.summary: The same switch as Pin and as the status bar menu, at the right of each tag, with its "…" just before it.

variants.label: The tag fills when on
variants.summary: Click the tag itself: filled when it's on this session, a faint outline when it isn't. Only the "…" at the right.
variants.risk: On and off differ only by how strong the tag looks.

steps.headline: Tag actions: the app's small menu instead of a row of boxes and buttons.
steps.notice: Rename turns the tag into a name box in place; Change colour shows one row of colours; Archive is a menu item now, not a button on every row; Delete… asks first, with the red Delete where the main button goes.

variants.label: Last round
variants.summary: Colour dot, name box, Archive and Delete all opened under the tag at once.

variants.label: Small menu
variants.summary: The same menu right-click uses: Rename, Change colour, Archive, Delete…; only the one you pick opens.

steps.path: The session list at the top of the window
steps.headline: A pinned session shows a small pin instead of the amber "Priority" tag.
steps.notice: Same in the Resume cards and on the status bar's tag chip.

variants.label: Today
variants.summary: An amber "Priority" tag beside the other tags.

variants.label: Pin
variants.summary: A pin before the tags; hover says "Pinned to top".
